tuning.text: Harden webhook delivery retries with exponential backoff and a dead letter queue, then verify idempotent redelivery in the integration suite before the phase closes.
Reduce flaky integration tests by isolating the scratch database, pinning ports and cleaning temporary directories after each run of the suite.
Plan the schema migration for tenant billing records and gate the rollout behind a feature flag with a rollback checklist for the phase.

heldout.text: Add rate limiting to the public API gateway, return retry-after headers and document the limits in the integration guide for the phase.
Rotate the signing keys used for session tokens and verify in the end to end suite that expired tokens are rejected after the rotation.
Improve startup latency of the worker daemon by caching configuration and deferring optional plugin loading until first use in the phase.

projectPk.title: Webhook retry budget and dead letter queue
projectPk.body: Webhook delivery retries use exponential backoff with a retry budget; exhausted deliveries move to the dead letter queue and redelivery stays idempotent.

projectPk.title: Scratch database isolation for integration runs
projectPk.body: Each integration run gets its own scratch database and a pinned port, and the temporary directories are removed in a cleanup trap.

projectPk.title: Billing migration behind a feature flag
projectPk.body: Tenant billing schema migrations ship behind a feature flag and keep a rollback checklist next to the migration.

projectPk.title: Gateway rate limit and retry-after headers
projectPk.body: The API gateway enforces per-key rate limits and returns retry-after headers; the limits are listed in the integration guide.

projectPk.title: Session signing key rotation
projectPk.body: Session token signing keys rotate on a schedule; tokens signed with a retired key are rejected once the grace window ends.

projectPk.title: Worker daemon startup cache
projectPk.body: The worker daemon caches parsed configuration and loads optional plugins lazily to keep startup latency low.

projectPk.title: API role idempotency convention
projectPk.body: api-dev writes idempotency keys for every retried request and checks them before the handler runs.

foreignPk.title: KnowMe avatar rendering pipeline
foreignPk.body: The KnowMe avatar pipeline renders sprites in the browser and falls back to the default sprite when a render fails.

foreignPk.title: KnowMe session avatars
foreignPk.body: Avatar sessions in KnowMe keep a signed token per browser tab so a refreshed tab reuses the avatar state.

foreignPk.title: KnowMe phase review notes
foreignPk.body: Each KnowMe phase ends with an avatar review; the sprite budget for the phase is listed in the design guide.

foreignPk.title: KnowMe avatar test database
foreignPk.body: KnowMe avatar tests share one database between suites and leave sprite files in the temporary directory.

foreignPk.title: Actix middleware ordering
foreignPk.body: Actix wraps middleware in reverse registration order, so the logger must be registered after the compression wrapper.

foreignPk.title: Actix worker thread startup
foreignPk.body: Actix starts one worker per core; application data is cloned into each worker at startup.

foreignPk.title: Actix tenant extractor
foreignPk.body: A custom Actix extractor resolves the tenant from the host header before the handler runs.

surrealLessons.content: Role lesson: api-dev retries idempotent writes and records the idempotency key before the handler runs.
Project lesson: integration runs use a scratch database and a scratch port so suites never touch shared state.
Project lesson: webhook and gateway changes are verified by the integration suite, never by mocks of the delivery path.
Global feedback: keep each change small, finish the implementation, then run the integration gate once.
